prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 16:9 cinematic style exploration still for an approximately three-minute Chinese AI brand film playing at an industry event for adults.
Input images: image 1 is the official Chacha character identity reference; image 2 is the official Chamei identity reference. Use only the characters from these sheets, never copy reference-sheet labels or layout.
Scene: a witty, energetic AI community demo counter. Chacha, left, presents one mint-green product card with a simple robot icon. Chamei, right, leans over the counter reacting with delighted curiosity. On the counter are only three clearly separated cards with robot, picture and speech-bubble icons, a small watermelon slice, and a compact laptop. A few large geometric architectural shapes suggest an open contemporary studio; avoid clutter.
Identity: Chacha is the white squat round mascot with small round black eyes, tiny black nose and smile, mint-green T-shirt, a large white tail with exactly two black marks. Keep the official broad face silhouette, not a generic round cat, no whiskers. Chamei has an orange bear-ear hood including the hood's tiny bear face, brown fringe and side hair, rosy cheeks, simple black oval eyes, round hands. Keep Chamei waist-up because the source only defines upper body. Preserve proportions and identity while translating the drawing medium.
Composition: single full-bleed landscape cinematic frame, eye-level medium-wide two-shot, characters clearly readable and expressive, ample breathing room, sharp art direction, professional adult-facing brand animation, playful but not a nursery illustration. Palette: mint and deeper green, warm cream, orange-brown, charcoal black with small watermelon-red accent. No headings, labels, subtitles, mock brand logos, watermark or extra characters. Props are schematic metaphors, not accurate product UI.
Style/medium: sharply designed hand-drawn cel animation keyframe. Clean confident variable-weight black ink outlines, crisp flat colors with exactly one hard-edged shadow tone, angular graphic background perspective, stylish animated sitcom energy. Strong cinematic framing, expressive poses. No soft 3D shading, no plastic, no paper fibers, no pastel watercolor. It should feel noticeably more dynamic and graphic than a cute storybook drawing. A single dramatic diagonal ray of late-afternoon light unites characters and room without overcomplicating shadows.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: professionally art-directed HYBRID ANIMATION style board for a Chinese AI brand film, 16:9 landscape. Four equally sized landscape cinematic frames in a tidy 2x2 grid separated by a thin warm-cream gutter. No captions, numbers, labels or any typography.
Primary request: show how a single pair of identically drawn 2D characters can remain cohesive across shallow 3D stage environments and flat motion-graphic information overlays. These are four connected conceptual beats illustrating visual transitions, not four separate illustration styles. Industry-event audience, sophisticated witty brand animation, modern editorial art direction, not preschool.
Input image 1: official Chacha character ID ONLY. Input image 2: official Chamei character ID ONLY. Do not copy reference sheet annotation or composition.
Characters MUST stay visibly 2D hand-drawn flat cel characters in ALL FOUR frames: identical confident charcoal outlines and flat colors, small simple facial features, no volumetric sculpted faces. Chacha white broad rounded face, mint-green T-shirt, little ears, black dot eyes/nose, large white tail with TWO black marks. Chamei orange bear-ear hood with tiny bear face on it, brown fringe and side hair, rosy cheeks, simple oval eyes and round hands. Preserve official recognizable silhouettes. Both appear waist-up in every frame, about same apparent size; Chamei lower body never invented. No additional mascots.
Environment in ALL frames: the SAME minimal physical stage language of large warm-cream matte architectural platforms, mint/deep-green folded walls and one curved portal. Soft upper-left directional studio light, believable mild ambient shadows on the SET. Characters cast small integrated contact shadows on counters but keep their faces flat, as elegant multiplane animation/compositing rather than sculpted toys.
Panel top left: eye-level medium two-shot at an AI community demo counter. Chacha left and Chamei right inspect ONE mint rectangular card with simple black robot icon. The card is a crisp flat graphic, counter and room are shallow 3D. One small watermelon slice, lots of negative space. Card occupies center.
Panel top right: SAME characters, SAME composition and facial model, same card expands upright behind the counter into a large mint rectangular aperture with rounded corners. This is an intermediate match-shape transition; through aperture we see a simple model workbench. Keep mint rectangle clearly related to card from first frame. Flat white arrows and tiny black circuit lines are graphic overlays in same stroke family.
Panel bottom left: inside the model workbench. Same character render and size; Chacha left and Chamei right gesture toward three mint/cream dimensional blocks bearing clean flat black icons for picture, sound and text, joined by one clear mint line. Flat informational graphics have precise 2D appearance over the 3D stage. Portal's rounded rectangle remains in background, compositional anchor.
Panel bottom right: same mint rounded rectangle becomes a presentation screen on a minimal business event stage. Same characters flank center, same outfits and draw style. On screen three flat simple symbols of a creator/video, handshake and audience dots connected by one line. No fake performance data, no numbers. Screen and counter geometry maintain prior frames' family. A single small halftone comic burst accent adds energy WITHOUT changing character rendering.
Palette locked throughout: warm cream, mint green, deep green, charcoal, character orange-brown; very small red watermelon accent. Camera eye-level, 45mm equivalent, medium-wide, consistent perspective and scale. Clear non-cluttered scenes. No actual UI or logos, no subtitles, no text or watermarks. The appeal must come from intentional 2D/3D interaction and visual storytelling, not random collage or changing character identity.
